content:
ali-ops: Heads-up — RBAC migration v2 lands tomorrow. Quick check: will this change what fields we emit in audit events? I think role_id -> role.name rename will affect SIEM mappings.

ben-sec: good catch. yes we're renaming role_id to role_name. Need to ensure both present for a transition window.

clara-iam: plan is to write both keys for 30 days: keep `role_id` and add `role_name`. Afterwards we'll emit only `role_name` and bump audit_schema_version.

dave-sre: any impact on webhook signature / KMS envelope? customers using webhook->S3->SIEM pipelines may rely on exact field paths.

ali-ops: KMS envelope stays same. concern is Splunk/Datadog parsers that reference `user.role.id` path. we should document the deprecation and provide example payloads.

eve-customer-success: flagging customers with custom SIEM parsers: ACME, FinApps. Can we provide sample mapping diffs so they can update ahead of time? :eyes: 

ben-sec: yes. I'll draft a short mapping table and add `audit_schema_version: "2->3"` and a `deprecated_fields` array in the payload metadata.

clara-iam: proposed payload sample:
```json
{
  "audit_schema_version": "3",
  "event": "role.change",
  "user": {"id": "u-123", "email": "u@example.com", "role_name": "admin", "role_id": "r-12"},
  "resource": {"id": "res-1"}
}
```
Please review.

dave-sre: looks good. Suggest adding `field_mappings` metadata for SIEM on ingest with recommended JSONPath for old and new fields.

ben-sec: agree. Also, add a webhook header `X-Redwood-Audit-Version: 3` to simplify routers that only look at headers.

ali-ops: action items: 1) Add dual-field emit for 30d 2) Add header `X-Redwood-Audit-Version` 3) Publish migration guide and sample parsers 4) Notify ACME/FinApps via CS

eve-customer-success: I'll open the outreach docs and ping their SRE contacts. ETA EOD today.

audit-bot: deployment scheduled: rbac-migration/v2 -> prod at 2024-12-11T02:00:00Z :rocket:

ben-sec: also adding a small consumer-side schema test in our audit-delivery CI to reject payloads missing either role_id or role_name during the roll period.

clara-iam: sounds good. One more: KMS envelope uses `encrypted_metadata` — let's ensure the metadata includes `audit_schema_version` in plaintext so routing rules can read without decrypting.

dave-sre: +1. That'll help SIEM mapping and streaming routers.

ali-ops: thanks everyone. I'll update the PR with the sample payload and header change. tagging for visibility @here
